title: Research: temporary two-output sum anchor (local construction)
body:
## Result

Adds an exact reversible local block over `F_2` with two clean required outputs:

- `F0 = P`, `F1 = Q`, and `Fi = P + Q + Ri` for `i >= 2`, where `P`, `Q`, and the `Ri` are independent rank-one products.
- The schedule temporarily shears `F0` into `P + Q`, fans that value to the remaining targets, then restores `F0 = P`. It uses `q` rank-one children and `q` affine additions, no scratch helper, copies, or frame changes. The inverse restores the two anchors and all arbitrary dirty accumulators.
- The `q` output-slice matrices are independent, proving exact tensor rank `q`; the displayed decomposition attains it.
- At `q=112`, the temporary shear saves 108 affine additions relative to ordinary separate-anchor fanout (112 rather than 220), with the same 112 joint rank-one children.

## Conditional profile screen

Seven source-compatible replacements of independent 332-child output evaluations by 112-child blocks would save 1,540 rank-one calls and add 784 affine additions. The exact pinned moment ceiling passes the 5% target at tariff `e=183` rank-one-equivalent units per block and fails at `e=184`; charging each of the 112 additions as one unit (`e=112`) still passes. The ordinary 220-add separate-anchor fanout at unit tariff returns to the selected profile and fails. The profile screen is conditional: no matching selected-provider occurrences, clean-output availability, chronological placement, or supplier transfer is claimed, and selected kappa is unchanged.

This changes the output-state contract relative to open PR #2213: that construction places a rank-three common sum in one clean output; this block preserves two distinct clean product outputs and temporarily shears one into their sum.

## Reproduction and checks

- `python3 -I -O -B research/complex-two-output-sum-anchor-seed65ce19/verify.py` — passed locally on Python 3.14.7. Symbolic checks cover `q=3..112`; Boolean replay exhausts all source and dirty-target assignments for `q=3,4,5`; four mutation controls pass.
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-two-output-sum-anchor-seed65ce19 --check-only` — passed.
- The registered package replay requires Python 3.12, unavailable locally. GitHub CI will provide that replay.

Base, selected record, catalogue, ceiling engine, and one-output predecessors are pinned in `SOURCES.json`. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18937965.
